preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
The lengths of the strings M_string and N_string must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= M for x, y in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid coordinates (x, y) within the bounds of the table.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly Q characters, each representing the winner for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join('1' if winner else '0' for winner in winners)
postconditions.description: The output must correctly represent the winners for each query based on the game rules.
